title: Suraj Rivera — Biography

title: Tidewatch — Open-Source Uptime Monitor
content:
Tidewatch is an open-source uptime monitor built by Suraj Rivera with FastAPI and HTMX.

How it works. A scheduler checks every registered HTTP endpoint once a minute from three regions and records status codes and response times in PostgreSQL. An endpoint is only marked down when at least two regions agree, which removed almost all false alarms caused by a single flaky network path.

Alerts. When an endpoint goes down or recovers, Tidewatch sends a message to Slack and an email, and it can call a custom webhook. Alerts are grouped so that an outage affecting many endpoints produces one notification instead of hundreds.

Status pages. Every project gets a public status page that shows ninety days of uptime history and current incidents. The pages are rendered on the server and cached, so they stay fast even during an incident with heavy traffic.

Tech stack. The API and scheduler are written in Python with FastAPI and APScheduler, the check workers use asyncio with httpx, and the dashboard uses server-rendered templates with HTMX instead of a single-page app. Everything ships as one Docker image, and a GitHub Actions workflow runs the test suite and publishes releases.

Results. Tidewatch monitors more than 2,000 endpoints for about 150 small teams, has over 1,800 stars on GitHub, and runs on a single small virtual machine.

title: Ledgerly — Personal Budgeting App
content: Ledgerly is a personal budgeting web app by Suraj Rivera with a React frontend and a Python API that categorises bank transactions automatically with a small text classifier.

title: Quaypoint — CLI for Database Migrations
content: Quaypoint is a command-line tool by Suraj Rivera, written in Go, that previews PostgreSQL migrations against a copy of production data and warns about long table locks before they happen.

title: Designing Idempotent APIs
content: In the article "Designing Idempotent APIs", Suraj Rivera explains how idempotency keys prevent duplicate payments when clients retry requests.

title: What Two Regions Taught Me About False Alarms
content: In this article, Suraj Rivera describes how requiring agreement from two monitoring regions cut false outage alerts in Tidewatch by 95 percent.
